Data extraction: nginx config directives as KeyValue nodes

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"nginx\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("worker_processes 4;\nerror_log /var/log/nginx/error.log;\n", config);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
